title: Christmas Eve: rope-drop to the Light Up the Night show at USJ, then a KFC party barrel at Kujō House

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out the door at 06:20 for rope drop; passports, ICOCA/Suica and the Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass in pocket.

stops.name: Konbini breakfast by Kujō station
stops.plan: Onigiri, coffee and snacks to eat in the gate queue; nobody wants to pay park prices for breakfast.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line Kujō → Nishikujō (1 stop), JR Yumesaki line Nishikujō → Universal City (pass covers the JR part), walk to the gate, about 45 min door to door

stops.name: Universal Studios Japan – Universal Holiday Wonders
stops.plan: Rope drop: Super Nintendo World first (free timed-entry in the app if no Express), lunch inside, Joy of Lights and the 17:30 Light Up the Night show in Gramercy Park, then out. Dec 24 hours and prices are unverified (no Google hours listed either): confirm on usj.co.jp.
stops.price: about ¥10,900 pp Studio Pass (dynamic; Express Pass 5 from ¥16,800 extra)
stops.transport: JR Yumesaki line Universal City → Nishikujō, JR Osaka Loop line → Bentenchō, walk to Life, about 40 min door to door

stops.name: Life Bentenchō
stops.plan: Supermarket run for the party: beer, chu-hi, sake, Christmas cake, salads and sides; split the bill eight ways.
stops.transport: Osaka Metro Chuo line Bentenchō → Kujō (1 stop), walk to KFC, about 31 min door to door

stops.name: KFC (Kujō) – Christmas Party Barrel pickup
stops.plan: Collect the reserved Christmas Party Barrels (reserve ahead; the store closes 21:00, so take a pickup slot before 20:00). Fallback: Life's fried chicken and party platters, bought on the stop before.
stops.transport: Walk back to Kujō House, 17 min

stops.name: Christmas Eve party at Kujō House
stops.plan: Barrels, cake and drinks at the house; an easy night with bed by about 23:00, because Christmas Day ends with a Round1 all-nighter.
